As predicted, your magic has scrambled Grid’s firewall.
But in doing so, it’s caused widespread data corruption and destabilization throughout the sector.
I’m no techie, but that doesn’t sound great.
Yes and no. Grid’s blockade is down, so we’re free to explore the sector. But we'll lose character data after each battle.
Destabilization’ was puttin’ it mildly. This place is fallin’ to pieces faster than Zee when one of those sad animal adverts come on.
Hey! I’ve met literal demons who couldn’t get through those commercials without shedding a tear.
The interaction between technology and magic has proven to be explosive and unpredictable.
It’s an effective way of circumventing Grid’s defenses, to be sure, but not one without risk.
So, our only option is to undertake an insanely dangerous and experimental course of action? Must be a Tuesday.
I know this is a serious, life-or-death situation we’re in, but something about navigating a virtual world and beating digital bad guys with magic feels...
... Like we’re playable characters in some sort of video game?
Let’s just hope it’s Grid that gets the “game over” and not us.
How you holdin’ up, luv?
Not gonna lie, this is a tough gig. But it’s still nothing compared to working the birthday party circuit.
Five-year-olds these days aren’t impressed unless you manipulate the very fabric of reality itself.
The sector is deteriorating quickly. We're running out of time.
Stand back. Ezilibats!
What did you do?
Hopefully bought us enough time for our grand finale. But we should pick up the pace, the spell won't hold for long.
We’re almost there. Let’s move.
Great news! I think. Where exactly is “there,” again?
With any luck, wherever Grid’s squirrelled away his crypto.
I have no bloody clue what crypto is, I just know I want it.
Phew, got out of there just before the curtain dropped. Did you find what you were looking for, Bruce?
I found something. It remains to be seen if it’ll help us contain Grid.
But I can’t imagine he would go through the trouble of encrypting it and hiding it away in the root of his data vault if it wasn’t important.
Well, I’ll leave you to it then.
The only thing I’m interested in cracking open is a nice bottle of whisky.
By the mystical powers granted to me, I will protect this world.
I will always serve to protect Order. This is my sacred duty.
This time, I cannot stop Chaos with my own powers alone...
Come, follow me. Let us see what fate has in store.
I can feel that something isn't right in the order of the universe. I hope I'm wrong on this occasion, but...
I feel that the intrusion of the Crime Syndicate may have longer-reaching implications.
Perhaps I could use the perspective of another who also has a strong connection to the mystic.
Well, this is something reversed. Dr. Fate needing a second opinion? How can I help?
Zatanna, thank you for your assistance.
There seems to be something pulling at the fabric of the universe and it seems to be interfering with my attempts to discern what it is.
Hopefully together we can find out what the cause is.
Between the two of us, this shouldn't be a problem. ECNABRUTSID LAEVER!
It appears that we are not alone in this fight.
By performing certain tasks, Nabu has seen fit to grant us boons, which we can use to acquire items to aid us in our upcoming battles.
Zatanna, something does not feel right....ugh.....
Are you ok? You look…
FRAIL MORTALS!!! I, NABU, SHALL TAKE MATTERS INTO MY OWN HANDS!
Hooboy.
I can feel the presence of Nabu growing stronger.
Perhaps exploring the Crypt of Fate will help us decipher his machinations.
Lead the way.
Each City specializes in a particular reward. For example, Central City offers titanium.
Complete the first few levels of each city to  <color=#FAA520>earn new characters</color> and progress further.
You unlocked The Cheetah! Use The Cheetah in Keystone City now!
Look! We can see a signal wave move from Central City to Keystone City. We should investigate…
Activate Keystone City
Interesting… after we visited all five Cities, it looks like the pattern is changing.\nWe should  <color=#FAA520>come back each day</color> to see which cities we can next.
A city is active in Convergence. Get your  <color=#FAA520>daily reward</color> now!

Fill the Repel Damage bar by earning Battle Points and activating Sector Skills.

Each Area has different enemies and objectives for your League to tackle.
You can check League participation and objective completion here.

en: Waller says we're to take back Pokolistan in three phases: West, East, and South.
Keep away from the Manor unless you're looking for a fight.
Stay focused! Check the Briefing to refresh yourself on our current Missions if you must.
Grab whatever supplies you can at the Shop. We won't be here for long.
Pack your bags, you bag of bones. We're heading back to Pokolistan.
Why? Waller mad we forgot to pick her up a "My Specialized Military Task Force Went to Pokolistan to Assassinate Their Princess and All I Got Was This Lousy T-Shirt" t-shirt?
According to Waller, the death of that sadistic fairy tale princess created a power vacuum in Pokolistan.
In other words, you blasted both a metaphoric and literal hole through the head of the monarchy, and now the sharks smell blood.
More or less. And now the Great White that is the Crime Syndicate is circling.
Waller's "requested" we stop them from claiming Pokolistan for themselves and using its resources to enslave the planet.
So all in all, a pretty normal day for us then?
Do you think this shop carries souvenir spoons? I'm quite the collector.
Focus, skinless wonder. We don't have time to kid around. We need to stock up on supplies.
Madam, I never kid about adorably tiny, beautifully embellished decorative cutlery.
What is this place?
Nowhere special. Let's go.
Okay, but it's just that you seemed awfully mad at those Crime Syndicate goons for trashing the place for it to be "nowhere special."
Not to mention the verbal lashing you gave poor Weez when he chewed on the furniture. What gives?
Drop it, Scorpion.
Alright, alright, I can take a hint.
Wait, what am I saying? No I can't!
Then allow me to make it more explicit for you.
Get out of the manor and out of my sight or I will literally tear you a new one.
Wow, that is explicit, in more ways than one.
Waller has sent over an ordered list of tasks we're to complete as part of our mission to liberate Pokolistan from the Crime Syndicate.
Seems she's hoping we do things more "by the book" this time around.
Unfortunately for her, I never was much of a reader.
Cross me and I promise you, you'll regret it.
You sure you know what you're getting yourself into?
If you want to make it out of here in one piece, I suggest you leave now.
Allow me to demonstrate why they call us monsters.
With each defeat, they come back stronger. We need to hit them with all the strength we have.
With each defeat, they come back stronger. We need to look for vulnerabilities.
Their flamerthrowers have a flaw: If they're burning, using it hurts them, too!
This wave's armor and weapons are stronger than last one.
That big flame attack of theirs is getting even hotter.
If we could inspire fear in him, I believe this coward would become quite vulnerable.
DeSaad's resistance to our Superpower Damage is increasing even more!
His most frequent attack now seems to also cause its target to become exhausted.
His Superpower resistance is almost total. We should focus on physical attacks.
Steppenwolf's axe seems quite adept at hitting where it hurts the most.
Did that axe get sharper? The bleeding won't stop as soon anymore.
When he smells blood, his most damaging attacks hit even harder.
He now has nearly complete Physical resistance. We should focus on superpower attacks.
<color=#92df55>Red Hood</color>, your <color=#92df55>Critical Attacks</color> look like they might actually hurt. Perhaps I underestimated you.
Realized you can <color=#92df55>Block</color> my attacks, <color=#92df55>Ocean Master</color>? You're not as incompetent as I thought.
Your <color=#92df55>Debuffs</color> may slow me down, <color=#92df55>Sinestro</color>, but you haven't won yet.
Hoping to use your <color=#92df55>AoE attacks</color> to destroy my Kryptonite, <color=#92df55>Green Arrow</color>? Hah! I'd like to see you try.
Target that <color=#92df55>Kryptonite</color> all you want, <color=#92df55>Robin</color>. Even if you destroy it, you're still no match for me.
Planning to <color=#92df55>Sacrifice</color> yourself to defeat me, <color=#92df55>Pandora</color>? You must really be desperate.
<color=#92df55>Kid Flash</color>, correct? Let's see if your <color=#92df55>Healing</color> can stand up to my Nuclear Barrier!
Ugh, <color=#92df55>Batman</color> is here? There's no way my constructs can hold up to his <color=#92df55>Single Target attacks</color>...
Think you're going to penetrate my shield and make me <color=#92df55>Bleed</color>? I'd like to see you try, <color=#92df55>Two-Face</color>.
<color=#92df55>Killer Frost</color>, I see you've been honing your <color=#92df55>Basic Attack</color>. Maybe this won't be a waste of my time.
There's trouble at the Daily Planet, Stryker's Island, and LexCorp!
I will protect the people of Metropolis, no matter what.
I ought to check the Super-Computer for any distress signals.
The Fortress' robots should be able to process any resources I find into useful tech.
Dropping yourself into the middle of an international conflict? I've been known to step in it myself, but you stepped in it and smeared it all across the rug.
It was the right thing to do.
I get it, man. But you know some bureaucrat's gonna make a big stink about you going rogue.
And if I hadn't? Thousands would've suffered and died in a preventable war!
Maybe, but now everyone's gonna side-eye you and worry that you're everything the bad guys make you out to be - unpredictable, uncontrollable… a threat.
Luthor's definitely going to keep trying to turn the public against you, and nothing's too low or off-limits for him.
I have a duty to help people. A duty I intend to uphold, no matter what happens to me.
Thanks for bringing this stuff. This should help ensure Metropolis is protected even if I'm detained.
Wish I could do more to help, Superman, but the feds are putting anyone seen associating with you under surveillance.
And the last thing I need is them looking into my past… or my tax returns.
That's alright. The robots back at the Fortress of Solitude should be able to get or engineer anything else I need.
Lucky you. Closest thing I've got to a robot butler is a rice cooker that plays "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star."
We're here, Superman. Now what's this about?
I've received word S.T.A.R. Labs Metropolis is mobilizing a team to bring me in for "questioning."
If the worst should happen and I get detained, Metropolis will need someone else to protect it.
I know your team has already volunteered, but keeping this city safe is no easy task…
In other words, you want to test us to make sure we're up to snuff before passing off the responsibility.
More or less. If you can defeat me, I'll feel better about complying, knowing Metropolis is in safe hands.
Alright, Superman. I'm game. But don't expect me to hold back.
I'd expect nothing less.
All of this chaos in Metropolis… I don't doubt Lex is involved.
He knows I won't be able to turn a blind eye to it and must be engineering it to sway public opinion against me.
Well, he's right about one thing…
I will protect the people of Metropolis, even if that means walking into a trap.
I must know Metropolis is in safe hands.
Don't hold back. I want to see what you can do.
You sure you're ready for this?
Don't worry, I'll go easy on you.
Screw Flag and his goons for stirring up @#?! in Evergreen.
I don't start fights, but I do end them.
Whenever I don't know what to do, I turn to music.
Dad's probably got some crap we can use back at the house.
Hey, Peacemaker! Remember how you killed Rick Flag, Jr. during your Task Force X mission in Corto Maltese?
And how you've been wracked with guilt over the fact that you betrayed your team ever since?
Well, Adebayo says Junior's dad, Rick Flag, Sr., is out for your head! Isn't that great?
How is that great? He's going to @#?!*$& murder me!
Think about it. This is your chance to bury the hatchet… ideally after hacking him to pieces with it.
Dude, murder isn't always the answer. Maybe I should try, I dunno, talking to him.
It's like I don't even know you anymore.
Dad's probably rolling in his grave right now. He told me to never come back here.
But if there was one thing you could always count on him to be, it was heavily armed--
And prejudiced. Not to mention hateful. Oh, offensive too! And let's not forget the toxic masculinity…
Okay, maybe you could count on my dad to be more things than I thought.
But like I was saying, he has an entire secret lair full of weapons that--
That he used to terrorize and persecute innocent people.
Dude, we get it! My dad was a terrible person. Now can you PLEASE let me finish monologuing?
Sorry. I'm just saying, guy was an @#?!*$&.
And as I was SAYING, Dad's lair is full of weapons that'd be good to have on hand if I run into Flag.
Just in case things go south and I have to literally knock some sense into him.
This sucks, dude. All I wanted was to be treated like a true hero.
Now I'm on the top of A.R.G.U.S.'s Most Wanted list. I'll be lucky to end up back in Belle Reve.
If you ask me, they're overreacting. I mean, all you did was kill one guy who probably deserved it.
It's not like you, I dunno, taunted a puppy and made him cry or something.
You're not @#?!*$& helping, Vigilante.
Sorry, it's just... the Peacemaker I know wouldn't sit around whining and doing his face exercises all day.
He'd make those losers see he was a true hero, even if he had to bash a few heads in to do it.
Well I'm not gonna have much of a choice if they keep coming after me.
How did you find out about Corto Maltese anyway? I never told you about my mission there.
I know! I had to hear it from Adebayo. And how do you think that makes me feel?
Probably nothing, 'cause you're a sociopath.
Okay, you're right. But still. Best friends are supposed to tell each other everything!
I told you about the catgirl dakimakura I sleep with every night.
And you have no idea how much I wish you hadn't.
Now can we please focus on dealing with the A.R.G.U.S. agents all over Evergreen who are trying to kill me?
Okay, but we're circling back to this.
A true hero keeps the peace, no matter how many they have to kill.
If you're an enemy of peace, you're an enemy of me.
It's nothing personal, I just don't like you.
Let's rock!
<static>
Wait. You mean the League... you mean they’re all dead?
Batman. You CANNOT let him have the box.
It will be the END of your way of life!
Who are you? How did you hack our communicators?
<static>
Batman. My name is Harbinger. With me is the one called Pariah.
I know you don’t know us, and trust will be hard.
It’s the box. PANDORA’s Box.
It’s going to destroy your WORLD.
<static>
I get the feeling we're going to find out. But for now, let's focus on the mission at hand...
Batman, what Captain Cold said earlier... Did the Crime Syndicate really beat the whole Justice League?
I’m afraid so.
Are they... are they dead?
With all my heart...
...I hope not.
Batman, are you sure about this? If Wonder Woman’s really gone...
...I don’t think the Amazons would take that news well, frankly.
Come on, WE didn’t do it. It’s not like they’ll KILL us or anything, right?
I shoulda stayed in Gotham.
Okay, what’s going on? Why are they GOOD guys fighting with the BAD guys to fight against US?
I don’t know. But I’m guessing it has something to do with whoever unleashed those ENHANCEMENTS.
Have y’all noticed that every time we make a planned rendezvous, someone’s waiting to bash our heads in?
It crossed my mind.
Swell. The bats have a RAT.
I hope Superman’s here. We’re running out of time.
Worst than that, we’re running out of HOPE.
Batgirl. Batman. Arthur’s here. He’s returned.
Well, that’s good news, right?
I wish it was.
Whatever that thing is... I don’t think he’s my husband.
But you get in my way, you slow me down, I have six different toxins aimed at you right this minute.
I think maybe we’re chasing the wrong end of the snake, here.
Oooh, I love it when you use animal metaphors!
The Syndicate, the enhancements, they all started when Pandora’s BOX was stolen from Themyscira.
Hooking up with the island’s silver mirror, we can retrace the Box’s route, and... uh oh.
There’re Syndicate forces here already. And you’re not going to like who’s LEADING them!
Excuse me, is a Mr. Batman available for a friendly chat?
You’re not Pariah or Harbinger, and this is a closed com line. Who ARE you.
Oh, you may simply refer to me as an Outsider, Mr. Batman.
I’m going to suggest you stop trying to follow my tracks, detective. Or I shall be forced to do something I very much do NOT wish to do.
If Batman come here, me CRUSH him to show respect!
I’m afraid that honor belongs to ME, Bizarro.
Batman, what are you doing in Kahndaq? Last I heard, you were terrorizing Belle Reve!
Apparently, there’s some sort of imposter wearing my cowl. It’s... irritating.
We’re trying to trace the artifact you and your friends tried to steal, Cold. Pandora’s Box.
Honestly, you steal one calamity-bringing artifact and suddenly you're the bad guy.
If you want Pandora's Box so badly, Batman, then why don’t you come and take it?
What the in the world? If you’re here, who’s breaking into our comms?
Good question. Let’s find OUT.
Robin, I’m... dealing with a little bat problem in Kahndaq. I need surveillance at Wayne Manor.
What exactly am I looking for, Batman?
Some very bad people, I’d say. And some just MIGHT look like friends. No one gets in the cave, is that clear?
Hold the line. It’ll be done.
And Robin...
...bring some BACK-UP.
Wait... you’re saying Kal El’s ALIVE?
Uncertain, Supergirl. But he’s been spotted, we think. By reliable witnesses.
WHAT "reliable witnesses?"
Well, myself, for one.
The thing is... this is awkward.
The thing is, the Superman WE saw was batting for the wrong TEAM.
That’s impossible.
It’s unlikely, agreed. Can you do a scan of Smallville? We need to make sure he’s found, if he really is out there.
And Kara... be careful.
FLASH! I never thought I’d say this, but I’m actually glad to SEE you! Everyone thought the Syndicate KILLED you.
I remember the battle, then a flash, no pun intended.
Nothing after that.
Well, Batman’s trying to trace the box that those monsters came out of. He thinks if we can find it, we can send them BACK.
This honestly sounds more like a Zatanna thing than a ME thing.
Not a bad idea, now that you mention it...
Wait, you want ME to look for a possibly homicidal SUPERMAN? What am I supposed to do, throw white doves and rabbits at him?
Zatanna, magic affects us Kryptonians just like it affects humans. It’s one of our weaknesses.
All right. I’ll try.
ANNATAZ, YLF OT SILOPORTEM!
I don’t think I’ll ever get used to that.
I’m not used to being ordered around by flying rats, Batman.
You’re the most qualified for this, Captain Cold. I need you to get inside the ARGUS Base. See if they have the Box.
And WHY am I the lucky number who gets this honor?
Because you’re DRESSED for it, Cold.  It’s in the ARCTIC.
This is what I get for being FASHIONABLE.
It’s as I said, Batman. Aquaman is here, but...
But he’s not the Arthur you married. I’m sorry, Mera.
We’re getting reports of a handful of the missing Justice Leaguers—
...the PRESUMED DECEASED Justice Leaguers...
Tactful, Catwoman. Of the MISSING Justice Leaguers popping up in trouble spots all over the world.
How did you spot that he might be a duplicate of some kind?
Well, his pet octopus won’t go NEAR him.
Queen Hippolyta, Wonder Woman’s mother, says they’ve tracked the entity that stole Pandora’s Box from the care of the Amazons.
Nightwing and I stopped the villains from stealing the Box from the Gotham Museum of Antiquities.
I handed it over to Wonder Woman myself, thought it would be safer here.
It was a good instinct, Batgirl. You couldn’t have known.
Batman... what if all of this was my fault?
Cold! What are you doing back in Belle Reve? How did you even GET inside a maximum security metahuman holding facility?
Well, see, my old buddy MIRROR MASTER, he’s like a living skeleton key!
The Syndicate’s already broken free half the prisoners, Batman.
We wanted to see if there’s any still here that’ll come over to OUR side.
I wonder... whose side are YOU on, Captain?
Batman. We’re trying to break through, but there’s some kind of barrier around Earth... trying to STOP us, I think.
There isn’t much TIME. Earth is on the EDGE of EXTINCTION!
Listen, both of you. We’re fighting a war here against an enemy we can’t even SEE.
WHO IS IT who called for the Syndicate to come through Pandora’s box?
More importantly, can we STOP them?
We repelled the invaders, father. It was... odd.
Odd?
One of the invaders was ME.
There’s a lot of that going around.
I’ve scanned the entire county three times, Batman. There’s no sign of Superman that I can detect.
All our data says he was HERE.
Well, if he was, he’s gone now.
All right, Supergirl. I have another task for you.
Shoot.
There’s some sort of energy barrier around the Earth. I need you and Green Lantern to find the source and shut it DOWN.
Copy that.
FLASH. It’s really YOU, right?
No idea what you mean, but yes, it’s me, Batman. What’s up?
We’re looking for an artifact, it could save the world. You up for a search mission?
Sure. How big’s the area?
Well, just five continents, so far.
>Heh< Give me something HARD next time.
Okay, I’m officially taking charge of the search for Pandora’s Box, Batman. You coordinate the resistance to the Syndicate’s power grab, agreed?
I’m being replaced on a mission I started?
No offense, Batman. But this is kind of what I DO.
We’re going to Metropolis. I need a hero from there to help me search.
But we already LOOKED here for Superman!
Not Superman. Lois LANE.
Hello, Batman. Do you remember Bane, the man who BROKE you?
I remember putting you in prison, if that’s what you’re asking.
I am giving you a friendly warning, detective.
The A.R.G.U.S. Base is under MY protection. Do not trespass on what BANE safeguards.
We’ll see, Bane.
I broke you once. I can do it AGAIN.
COLD. We need you back at the A.R.G.U.S. Base, pronto!
Why would I want to go back to THAT godforsaken place?
We have reason to suspect that BANE is processing and stockpiling hordes of VENOM, the chemical mix that makes him superhuman.
Couldn’t you have been the brilliant detective the FIRST time I went?
Excuse me?
>Sigh< Never mind. I’m on it.
Mr. Batman. I thought I told you to quit following my TRAIL.
Outsider. I know you stole the box from Themyscira. And I suspect you opened it to summon the SYNDICATE.
Keep going, this is very entertaining.
If you open it again, you could curse the world to an endless PLAGUE.
Outsider...
I have to go. Last warning. Stop SHADOWING me.
>Transmission ended<
You thinking what I’m thinking?
He doesn’t have it. He lost Pandora’s Box!
Actually, this is good timing. We could really use you on our team.
This is your League's Challenge Difficulty Level. Earn League Points to unlock higher levels.
The higher the Challenge Difficulty Level, the better the rewards you'll earn!
Battle Effects can give your team a bonus under the right conditions. Tap an icon to see what it does.
To start the fight, you need to meet all Character Requirements. Tap the icon for details.
If the Outsider doesn’t have Pandora’s Box, then his PRIORITY is going to be LOOKING for it.
He’ll retrace his steps. We have to alert the Amazons.
Let me handle this, Batman. They’ll listen better if it comes from me.
AMAZONS. Your island is in DANGER.
The OUTSIDER may be heading your way. Can you STOP him?
We vow it.
To defend our people and our queen.
With our lives, if necessary.
We VOW it.
G’day, Batman. Fancy chattin’ with you from prison, like this!
Captain Boomerang! How’d you get access to our comm line?
Oh, I’m a resourceful bloke, once you get to know me.
I mean, I fight the world’s fastest man with a bent piece of WOOD, don’t I?
Harkness. The other Rogues are working with us. You help us save the Earth, I’ll speak to the authorities about an early parole.
Well, see, that’s right nice, but I’m afraid I’ve gone and paroled MYSELF.
I’ll still help, though. Earth’s a good Sheila and I’m quite FOND of her.
Batman? You there?
How’s your recon going, Flash? Any sign of the Box?
The trail’s led here, I think. If I can stay clear of the local metahumans, we might have a shot at recovering the Box before it causes any more damage.
I could use some help, Batman. I can run around the Earth in a blink, but it’s INTEL I need here.
Understood. Batgirl?
I know what you’re going to say.
We need the BIRDS OF PREY.
Okay, Birds. We have a mission and time’s running out.
We need every resource we HAVE to look for intel on the location of Pandora’s Box. Maybe we can do what the Flash CAN’T.
I’m in. Sitting around doing nothing was never my style anyway.
I’m ready. Let’s go HUNTING.
Nice. We’re back.
The one and only BIRDS OF PREY.
Batman. This is Harbinger.
Your champions, Green Lantern and Supergirl, are working on finding a hole in the shield around Earth.
But I’m afraid we’re running out of time.
We’re very aware, Harbinger. We’re doing all we can.
This is Pariah, Batman. My visions... I see your world run by MONSTERS. And I see continents cracking in half and volcanoes spewing fire.
You have to HURRY. Or that’s just the BEGINNING!
Well, we may not be the best of mates, but it’s nice to see you lot after being locked up for so long.
Imagine, the ROGUES working as HEROES for a change.
Good to see you, too, Digger. We need all the brainpower we can get.
Yeah, right, right. About THAT...
Oh, no. What have you done?
Well, I only reached out and brought in an old ALLY, haven’t I?
Hello, humans. I am told we have an ENEMY to rend into pieces?
This isn’t good.
Batman... I’ve got some disturbing news from Metropolis.
Can’t WAIT to hear this, Batgirl.
I spoke with Lois Lane. She said Superman came to visit her at the Planet. Told her everything was going to be okay.
Correct me if I’m wrong, but that’s GOOD news, isn’t it?
She said it wasn’t Superman. She’s positive.
It was something LIKE Superman.
We’re in trouble, Batman.
I think I underdressed.
I TOLD you the place was cold.
Gorilla City is a tropical zone. I don’t like this, EITHER.
Let’s get the venom and get OUT, right?
Watch out for Bane. I got a bad feeling he’s still HERE.
Status report, Robin.
Panic. People are frightened, Batman. They don’t know who to trust.
Let me suggest a dangerous option: We enlist the inmates at Arkham.
No. Absolutely not.
You have already recruited criminals from Belle Reve and Enclave M...
And they are motivated by self-interest. They need Earth to survive and they are aware of that.
Can you say the same of the inmates at Arkham?
Have you identified the creature pretending to be my husband, Batman?
Queen Mera. I regret to say we haven’t.
I hate to say this, but perhaps you should close the city dome. Make sure he doesn’t have access. Until we KNOW it’s safe.
I’m afraid we’re doing more than that, Batman.
We’re closing the dome to EVERYONE.
Even your people, Batman.
I’m sorry.
You have enough High-density Material to unlock more slots and level up your characters.
Use your High-density Materials to unlock more slots, allowing you to level up all your characters.
I will not allow intruders to defile Atlantis.
If you doubt my legitimacy as king, I'll gladly give you a demonstration.
A king's work is never done.
All of Atlantis' resources are at our disposal.
I overheard you talking to Bruce earlier. Don't tell me he came to interrogate me again.
I informed him you were not accepting an audience today. He said he would try again later.
If his theories about these doppelgangers are true, he'd be better off looking for the others who haven't returned.
He's just concerned. Frankly, so am I. We thought you had died at the Crime Syndicate's hands.
Then you showed up out of nowhere, refusing to elaborate on what had happened—
What's to tell? I barely escaped with my life, then hid away until my health had returned and I was sure they'd lost my trail.
But I searched the seven seas for you, checked all our secret places—
Don't worry, my Queen. All that matters is that I'm here now. And I'm not going anywhere.
That's what I'm afraid of.
Is it true? Do you intend to unearth the Seven Treasures?
We'll need their power to fend off the Crime Syndicate. I've ordered the armories opened up as well.
I'm sure Batman will be relieved to hear the might of Atlantis will be joining the fight.
I only have interest in protecting what's mine. I'm afraid the surface world is on their own this time.
I can't believe what I'm hearing. You really intend to leave the humans to their fates? To the whims of those monsters?
Don't tell me you're a bleeding heart for surface dwellers too.
Too?
I just mean, I thought you'd welcome my putting the needs of Atlantis first.
It's true that I do not share your love or devotion for humankind. But I've always respected it. Admired it, even.
For you to abandon them at the hour of their most need… this flies in the face of everything you've ever stood for!
Things change. I'm a different ruler now.
Clearly.
Orm Marius! I have long known you to be a traitorous coward and as slippery as an eel.
But to attempt a coup while Atlantis is already under attack by the imposters? That is truly underhanded, even for you.
This invasion is precisely why I must take the throne. Atlantis needs a ruler with a firm hand during this troubled time.
A king solely devoted to his kingdom, with strength enough to protect it.
Not a half-breed easily swayed by sentimentality who will inevitably drag Atlantis into the surface's war.
I can assure you, Atlantis is my only priority. But if you doubt me, brother…
I will gladly demonstrate my strength by using my firm hand to put an end to you here and now.
A threat? Your near-death experience with the Crime Syndicate has changed you, brother.
Or perhaps the imposters have breached more of Atlantis than we thought.
Intruders disguised as allies have breached Atlantean borders. The Men-Of-War are engaging as we speak.
Given the severity of the threat, I believe we should consider deploying the Kingsguard as well.
Are you certain?
I can assure you, the kingdom needs their protection far more than we—
No, I agree with you on that. My question is— are you certain these are actually doppelgangers?
How can we be sure these aren't our "friends" taking advantage of the confusion to seize our power for themselves?
We keep better company than that.
I hope so. But we should be ready to strike down anyone who threatens Atlantis, no matter how familiar the face.
On that, we agree.
Allow me to show you what a real king is capable of.
I will crush you like a wave crushes a ship against the rocks.
Watch how quickly the tides can turn.
The crown will be mine—if I must take it by force, so be it.
Feel the power of The Green!
I am the Avatar of the Green!
Everything I need is in my lab.
An avatar of the Green's work is never done.
I fear what the Parliament's ambition may try to make me do.
The Rot cannot be allowed to spread.
When the Crime Syndicate began their invasion of Earth, the Parliament of Trees were staunchly opposed to getting involved.
They watched thousands lose their lives and entire cities get reduced to rubble with their characteristic apathy.
"This is a human problem," they insisted with a disturbing amount of giddiness. "Let the Red's champion handle it."
Even in the midst of an apocalyptic threat, all they could think about was expanding the Green's reach and power.
Unfortunately for them—and us, for that matter—they're not the only ones hoping to take advantage of the Red's weakening.
The Rot is feeding off all the death and destruction the Crime Syndicate leaves behind in their wake.
Which means the Crime Syndicate is now the Parliament of Trees' problem. Or, more accurately, my problem.
So you're the source of the pestilence that's been spreading throughout my swamp.
I can't take all the credit. The toxins and viruses belong to a client of mine. I'm just field-testing them for her.
How can you go along with this? All this meaningless suffering and death…. You're putting whole ecosystems at risk!
I'll admit, the not-so-good doctor is disturbingly sadistic, even by my standards.
But her check cleared, so who am I to judge?
To think you'd do all this just for money… Clearly there's no point in trying to reason with you.
Unfortunately for you, you're not the only one with the power of science at your disposal.
And I think you'll find my lab well-stocked.
Dr. Isley? Don't tell me you're working for the Crime Syndicate.
Of course not. I serve only the Green.
Then our interests should be aligned. So why do you stand in my way?
Because you're not actually acting in the Green's best interests, are you? If you were, you'd heed the Parliament of Trees' call.
You'd fulfill your duty as the avatar of the Green and take this opportunity to dominate both the Rot and the Red.
You're right about one thing, Pamela. I am the avatar of the Green, which means I alone get to decide how to wield its power.
I will not turn a blind eye to people in need just to satisfy the Parliament's ambition.
And nothing you or the Parliament can do will change my mind.
Alone? Probably not. But together? Well, let me show you what we've been working up in my lab…
I thought I sensed someone tailing me.
It wasn't hard. I just followed the trail of death you've been leaving behind.
Sure beats breadcrumbs, don't you think? After all, it did such a good job luring you into my trap.
Wait! You can't do this.
That confident you'll win, are you? I assure you, I'm deadlier than I look.
That's not what I meant. You don't realize it yet, but the Rot is using you—you and the Crime Syndicate you've sworn allegiance to.
It's feeding off the decay you leave in your wake, festering and spreading and growing in strength.
Unless we do something, it won't be long until Sethe, the Rot's champion, is reborn.
If that happens, it won't stop until it's devoured or corrupted everyone and everything. The world as we know it will cease to exist.
Good. I hope the world does end. After all, what has it ever done for me?
Then I'm afraid you leave me with no choice.
The seeds of your defeat have already been planted.
You'd be surprised what even the tiniest spore is capable of.
The full power of the Green is mine to wield.
I know these swamps like the back of my hand.
So this is the world that shaped Kal-El.
I sense no discipline from these people... What a waste of potential.
Empathy is what's keeping them down. Pathetic.
Kryptonian strength shall thrive here.
I don't expect them to understand me. They shall kneel, regardless...
Or we will break them.
And Krypton will rise again. Starting here.
You. You're from here... but you're not like the others.
And you talk like you know it all, but you don't.
Careful now. This planet shall be mine soon.
And why should I care?
But move any closer, I will turn that fancy armor of yours into ice chips!
Interesting, you wield the cold of a dead world more than Kal-El.
I shall decide sooner or later, whether you're an ally... or an inconvenient.
Move along now, a general needs to stack up his supplies.
Another human pretending to wield the power of a god.
You know I could just sneeze and turn you into vapor, right?
Chemical tricks. Kryptonians have surpassed such "technology" ages ago.
The sense of false superiority is glowing…
...It's also glowing inside of a blast radius, just so you know.
Nuclear fire, interesting…
Such a shame you wield it, yet lack the discipline to control it.
Now move along. I'm paying a visit to these so-called "heroes".
I'm not going anywhere.
You surviving our first meeting does not impress me.
I'm not going anywhere.
Your lingering can only mean your desire to form an alliance. I haven't made up my mind yet.
Or I'm just here to see what you want with this planet.
This planet's potential has been held down by weaklings.
It needs order, something your kind has never mastered.
And with order, comes strength in unity. My conquest has already started.
With order, comes chaos. Are you sure you're here to conquer, or to destroy?
Conquest is merely destruction with purpose.
Life here is weak and chaotic, it needs my reshaping.
Earth is just the foundation for Krypton's new future.
I've bent enemies before. Bending planets should not be a problem.
Soon, galaxies shall kneel before Zod.
Kneel, and be spared from the reckoning
Earth falls today—Krypton rises forever.
Your strength is merely dust beneath my heel.
Submit to me, or hear your own screams echo in eternity.
People don't just unleash madness for no reason. It’s something they've been suppressing every day.
Sanity is merely a costume that Gotham put on.
Strip away the lie that tomorrow will be better, and watch how quickly their minds rot in the present.
Oh how thin the floor really is beneath their morals...
Batman thinks I’m the sickness, but I’m just the diagnosis Gotham has been avoiding.
Batsy is showing up late as usual.
How long does he have until Gotham goes crazy?
Five minutes, tops.
Ooooh, new record!
Why does he always have to miss all of the fun...
Does that mean we're going to start without him?
As always.
You're late, Bats.
This ends now.
Oh, you say that every single time. Don't you have any creativity?
A lot of people will get hurt. End this now.
They always do. That's the punchline.
I won't let you win.
Funny thing is, you already did... by showing up.
I have a funny feeling you might just finally snap today...
You are a case study, just begging to be solved.
Careful now, doctor. Every man who tried to solve me ended up needing treatment.
You're not just chaos. You're chaos without a purpose. Let me understand you more.
You want control. I get it. Give me The Bat and we can call it an alliance, best I can do.
Ahhh yes, Batman is the key to you...
You're standing closer to the punchline, doctor
This alliance ends when I’m done with you.
They're all the same. Every smile is a compromise, every rule followed out of fear instead of belief.
All I have to do is remove the illusion, and they’ll happily turn on each other and their own false morals.
As for The Bat... Every rule he clings to is just a cage he built so he doesn’t have to admit how much he enjoys the thrill of the hunt...
I don’t want to break him. I want him to realize how close he’s always been to laughing with me and my jokes, hahahaha...
Are you punching? Or are you waving hello?
Is that all you've got?
Hahahahaha
Smile! This is the part where it all goes wrong for you!
This place feels cold compared to the sun of Themyscira.
I am the Lion of the Amazons! I'm here to ensure your league has a heart as strong as its armor.
The Well of Souls taught me that every hero carries a ghost. I see many standing among you.
Diana speaks well of your courage, but a Queen trusts only what she sees in the heat of the battlefield.
Tell me, which of these 'gods' among you is ready to spar?
Hello, Queen. I trust our base meets your standards.
It is impressive, though I prefer the sun of Themyscira to the cold of this place.
I see. If you need to strengthen your weapon, you can find what you need here.
I have everything I need. My staff has served me well for centuries.
Even so, we have equipment that could make your Staff of Understanding even more powerful.
How do you know about my staff?
It’s a powerful instrument of truth.
Then you honor it, and yourself.
You’ve spent too long in the shadows of the Gate, sister. Our heart is true.
Faith is a luxury of the sun-drenched, Diana. I trust only what is forged in battle.
Then let our weapons speak. If you won't take my word, take my strike.
A Queen does not yield to plain speeches. Prove these 'heroes' are worthy of the Amazonian flame.
They are. And I will show you that even a Lion can find a pride worth fighting beside.
Bold words. But remember, I was the First Champion before you were born.
I haven't forgotten. That is why I’m not holding back.
Good. Let the Staff of Understanding reveal the truth of your convictions!
You held back in our first bout. Bring your full strength, sister.
I didn't want to break the Base. But if you insist, the Lion shall be unleashed.
A Queen's mercy is a gift, but her power must be absolute.
Then prepare yourself. You are no longer fighting a guardian, now you face a Sovereign.
Show us the true power of the Lion of Themyscira!
I held the line at Tartarus for an eternity. I will not falter here.
My crown is a promise to be the shield my sisters deserve
True power isn't found in a throne, but in the courage to stand alone.
I am the Lion of Themyscira! Hear my roar and know peace.
Face the Lion, and see if your heart is pure enough to survive.
I’ve faced stronger opponents than any of you!
My crown was forged in battle, not given by chance. Prove you are worthy!
The Staff of Understanding sees your fear.
The sands of Kahndaq have tasted the blood of a thousand tyrants.
Five thousand years have not silenced the screams of my people under the pharaoh’s lash
I have carved my homeland's safety out of the living rock, and I shall be the last wall that never falls.
The Wizard gave me a name, but the gods of Egypt gave me their souls.
Their names are written in my bone, and their might is my only counsel.
My strength is not for glory, and my past is not for regret. As long as I breathe, Kahndaq shall never know a master.
Chaos is a disease, and fear is the only cure. The weak need a hand to choke them into submission.
Fear is a tool, but strength is the foundation. I am the monster my people require to remain free.
Your Kahndaq is a single grain of sand. You must impose your will upon the stars themselves to find true peace.
I do not care for the stars, only my soil. My lightning does not negotiate with chaos, it erases it.
Then we agree. 'Mercy' is just a word used by cowards who lack the spine to deliver justice.
The Justice League hesitates while the world burns, I do not.
You rule through terror, Black Adam. This isn't protection, it’s a prison.
Your 'justice' is a luxury the weak cannot afford. I do what is necessary.
True strength doesn't need to break people to lead them.
I am the wall that keeps the monsters away. You are just a guest on my soil.
Then I’ll have to show you that no one is above the law. Not even a king.
Your laws are dust in the wind.
We have the power of gods, but we aren't meant to be their judges.
Then you waste the gift the heavens gave you. I am the judge, the jury, and the storm!
Brace yourself, Kryptonian!
Black Adam, put down your rage. There is a path to peace that doesn't require a throne built on fear.
Peace is the dream of the sheltered. I live in the reality of the storm.
I see the man you were before the lightning. You loved your people, do not let that love turn into a cage for them.
My 'love' is a shield of iron. I would rather they be caged and alive than slaughtered.
The gods gave us this power to inspire the world, not to break it.
The gods gave me power because I had the will to use it.
If you will not listen to reason, then you must listen to the truth of my blade. I cannot let this stand.
Today, your lasso will find no truth, only the heat of the bolt.
Brace yourself, Princess of Themyscira!
I was born a slave beneath a tyrant’s whip. Now the lightning of the gods answers only to me.
Kings and heroes alike have tested my will. All of them learned the same truth.
The gods gave me their power to protect my people.
Those who threaten Kahndaq will face their judgment. Kahndaq will never bow again!
You come to my home seeking glory? You will find only a grave in the sand.
The gods have already decided your fate, I am merely the executioner.
I have outlasted empires and broken gods. Do you truly think you are any different?
Kneel now, and your end will be swift.
I’ve seen more fortified camps in the middle of a sandstorm.
If you were expecting the Princess of Themyscira, you’re out of luck. I don't do diplomacy, and I certainly don't do mercy.
The name is Artemis, of the Bana-Mighdall. I prefer a clean battlefield over a crowded grave.
My axe is getting restless and my enemies aren't going to kill themselves.
The air in this tower is too thin. I miss the smell of gunpowder and the Akaba sands from our first run.
Careful, you're sounding nostalgic. I figured you'd be happy to trade a literal pit in Hell for a view of the skyline.
Fair point. We’ve survived Bizarro’s tantrums and the Bow of Ra, a few 'corrupted' heroes shouldn't be much harder.
I remember you saying that right before that giant shadow-beast nearly bit your head off in Qurac.
We make a lethal team. The Justice League plays by the rules, but we’ve already died and come back, we know how to win.
That’s the plan. Let’s show these 'false gods' that the Outlaws don't stay down, no matter how hard they hit.
Stand down, Shim'Tar!
In the desert, we don't 'stand down' until the job is done, Princess.
Must everything be a trial of blood? You are still my sister, despite your arrogance.
Themyscira is your home, Diana. The sand and the struggle are mine. Now, draw your sword.
Then let the gods judge our intent. Defend yourself!
The gods aren't watching, Princess. Let's go!
Sisterhood is not a title you wear like armor, Artemis. It is the bond that ensures no Amazon stands alone.
Easy for you to say when your 'sisters' have golden halls and a queen to kiss their bruises.
Blood or geography does not define us. The same fire of the gods burns in both our hearts.
In my tribe, we sharpen our steel first. If your crown is worth anything, it’ll hold against my axe.
Enough sentiment. Let’s see if that sisterly talk can block a strike from the Shim’tar!
Nice place you guys have here. A bit too much machinery and 'hope' for my taste, but the coffee isn't half bad.
Just don’t expect me to start wearing a cape and smiling for the cameras. I’m just here to do my job.
Keep your hands off the axe. Seriously. Last time someone tried to lift it, he nearly took his own toes off.
So, are we going to keep talking about 'univeral security' all day, or are we actually going to go out there and break some things?
Don't worry, I'll make sure they put something nice on your headstone. If there's enough left of you.
You clearly weren't built for the front lines.
You’re fighting like a Themysciran, all grace and no guts. Hit me for real!
Is that your best? I’ve had tougher fights with my own reflection.
Step right up, bastiches! The Main Man’s in town, and the first frag is on the house!
I don't care who’s right or who’s wrong, I just care who’s got the biggest bounty and how many teeth I get to knock out chasin' it.
Make it quick! I got a date with a school of space-dolphins at six, and I ain't missin' 'em for a low-rent contract like you.
Step back from the Hog, bastiche!
One scratch on the paint and I’ll show you how I redecorate with your face.
I didn’t authorize a bazaar in my base, Lobo. Pack this up.
Chill out, Spooky! This ship was lookin' too clean, it needed a little 'Main Man' grease to feel like home.
You’re tracking Czarnian engine oil onto a multi-billion dollar floor. What are you doing here?
I’m providin' a service! Your tech is all 'non-lethal' junk.
I don't allow lethal contraband on this base. Follow the rules!
Rules are for those who can’t take a punch. I’ve got hooks here that can peel a moon like an orange.
You’ve got five minutes to pack up this 'Black Market' of yours and get off my base.
Relax, Bastiche! I’m helpin' you out! I showed you that your security system was so easy to crack.
I’m not paying you for 'security,' Lobo. You've got exactly sixty seconds to explain why you’re selling frag grenades in my base.
Lobo, I’ve seen the contract the Syndicate put out.
This isn't who you have to be. You could use that strength to actually help people for once, instead of just hunting them.
Pipe down! Helping people don't pay for premium Spacehog fuel or the best cigars in the sector.
The Syndicate’s got deep pockets, and they want a Kryptonian trophy for the mantle.
I tried to be patient, but you’re putting lives at risk for a paycheck.
Save the heroic speech for someone who gives a frag, Big Blue!
Then I’m done talking, I won't let your greed hurt anyone else.
That’s the spirit, Scout! I was worried you’d just lecture me to death.
I’m tellin’ ya, Bowl-cut...
You’re the only frag-head in the Corps who can actually take a punch without cryin’ to the Guardians for a band-aid!
And you're the only bastiche who can drink an entire Oan power-battery and still ask for a refill!
You still owe me fifty credits for that last round, Lobo!
Fifty?! I saved your life that night from that ugly, gray skinned monster!
That was your reflection in a mirror, you drunken fool!
Lobo? Do all Czarnians have red eyes or are you just not getting any sleep?
Yeah, yeah, laugh it up, fish-boy. I see you're still wearing orange and talking to sardines.
I command the fury of the oceans, bounty hunter. And they are far more than "sardines." In fact, I have some friends who are quite eager to meet you.
Wait. Friends? What kind? Don't tell me...
Oh, yes. My friends who are sleek, intelligent... with big, beautiful eyes...
Holy frag... Earth dolphins?! Real, majestic sea-angels?! Where are they?!
Oh, nowhere. They have better things to do than meet with you. I just wanted to see you beg.
You fraggin' fish-bastiche.
I don't care about your planet or your problems.
I care about the gold teeth and the credits.
Show me the moolah or get out of my face.
The Main Man don't do charity work.
Hope you got insurance, bastiche. The Main Man’s chargin' by the bruise!
The Syndicate’s payin' me a fortune to scrap ya. Nothing personal, just business!
Get ready for a first-class ticket to the stars... and I ain't providin' a parachute!
Quit shakin' and start fraggin'!
Every one of you has a spark. My job is to help you turn that spark into a bolt of lightning.
I've seen what this League can do. You’ve got the heart. Now let’s make sure you’ve got the power to back it up.
The world can be a dark place, but that’s why we’re here, to keep the lights on for the people who need us.
It’s not just about the suit or the powers. It’s about the person behind them.
A week, Bruce? During midterms? You can’t just pull me out like this is a weekend trip.
The Crime Syndicate won’t wait. We need your bio-electric power to stop them.
I get it, but I had to line up a substitute teacher just to leave.
The Wayne Foundation has that covered: classrooms, labs, and teachers. We need you here.
So now you’re buying my school? Fine, I’m in. But no bat-drones near my classroom.
Noted. Transport's leaving soon. Be ready.
I’ll be there, with gear and 40 essays to grade. And don’t touch my red pen.
Jefferson, this is exactly what they want. Don’t let them turn you against us.
They’ve got my kids. That’s all that matters.
I’m not letting you get closer.
Let us help. We can still stop them together.
Then prove it. Stay back!
If we walk, they win. If we fight, we lose you.
Then make it count, Bruce. Because I’m not moving.
West side’s lighting up, more of them is coming. I can feel it in the air.
They’ve stabilized a gateway. A breach point must've been established.
Then they’re flooding my city. Freeland’s under siege.
Then we take it back, sector by sector. No one gets left behind.
First priority is my people. Stay on me, I’ll get us where we’re needed most.
I’ve dealt with metahuman gangs and school board meetings in the same day, I can handle this.
I didn't put on this mask to be a god. I put it on so the kids in Freeland could sleep without the lights on.
You want to change the world?
Fine. But we’re doing it with class, character, and a whole lot of voltage.
I’m here to make sure you don't cross this line.
What are you on about the 'Greater Good'? These are my students' lives!
You want to push through me? Then get ready to feel the shock.
I’ll short out everything you’ve got.
S.T.A.R. Labs. Great.
This place looks like a giant, high-tech refrigerator.
Speaking of refrigerators, do they stock snacks here, or just war machines?
Wait… where’s Krypto?
I wonder if he ran to Clark.
Bark!
What's that, Krypto? Brigands? Bounty hunters? Space monsters?
Bark! Bark!
Oh, you want some kibble? A snack does sound good.
Bark! Bark!
Right back at you, buddy.
Bark!
Kara, snap out of it! the Syndicate is using a neural frequency to mask your memories!
The Syndicate are my masters, Superman, and they've ordered me to bury you in the ruins of this planet.
I can see the flicker in your eyes, Kara. Fight the signal and remember who you really are!
The only thing I remember is the weakness of your mercy, a flaw I’ve finally been purged of.
Then I’ll hold nothing back, because I know the real Supergirl would never forgive me for letting you commit these atrocities.
Don't worry about forgiveness, worry about yourself.
Okay, Ryuthe. New plan. You go stand behind that very thick, very reinforced lead wall over there.
I’m not hiding, Kara! I’ve got the pulse-mines! I can trip it up while you hit the head!
Kid, these guys are huge. You’re... what, four feet? Maybe five if you’re wearing the thick boots?
Please, let me help! I may not be as strong as you, but I can still do something.
God, you’re stubborn. You’re just like Krypto, just with less fur and more talking.
My cousin thinks this place is 'inspiring'?
I think it’s a giant refrigerator full of expensive toys.
But hey, at least the air conditioning works. Small wins, right?
Look, I’ve had a very long morning and a very red sun. If you’re Earth's 'Elite Protection,' this planet is in a lot of trouble.
Too bad for you, the sun is fueling my strength, and I’m going to use every bit of it against you.
I’ve survived the literal end of a world. You?
Superman says I should 'inspire' you. I think I’d rather just see if you can take a punch without falling apart.
Hell raised me. Your mortal shield won't survive my blade. Step aside!
I left the underworld behind, but I will gladly send you there.
You think you know darkness? I’ll show you what true torment looks like.
No one escapes my wrath.
Steel bends. Bone breaks. Let's see which one you are.
Stand down. I don't want to hurt anyone today.
Let's get this over with.
I was forged in a mine. Your little punches feel like rain.
They built this world out of glass and expect me not to shatter it. I’m not their savior. I’m their wake-up call.
Justice isn't a symbol in the sky. It’s the dirt under my fingernails and the blood spilled to protect the forgotten ones.
I don't fit into their pristine utopia. I was forged in the mines. My truth is heavy, raw, and absolutely unbreakable.
This isn't a costume for the cameras. It’s a tarp from a junk heap. But it still carries the weight of a world.

Explanation: Absolute Superman to Absolute Wonder Woman
en: The world doesn't need rulers. It needs hope.

Explanation: Absolute Wonder Woman to Absolute Superman
en: Hope without action is a prayer whispered into a storm.

Explanation: Absolute Superman to Absolute Wonder Woman
en: Then I'll stand beside them until they can stand alone.

Explanation: Absolute Wonder Woman to Absolute Superman
en: And I'll teach them strength so they never kneel again.

Explanation: Absolute Superman to Absolute Wonder Woman
en: Different paths, Diana. Same destination.

Explanation: Absolute Wonder Woman to Absolute Superman
en: Then let us lead by example, not by command.
The Syndicate's lying to you. Open your eyes before it's too late.
The Syndicate showed me the truth. Earth's leaders failed everyone.
Your 'truth' reeks of deception, Superman. They showed you lies.
The Syndicate freed me from doubt. You two cling to weakness.
Doubt kept you human, Superman They stripped that away on purpose.
You've been warned. This is your last chance. Walk away from them!
My only walk is forward. Through you both, if needed.
The air is pure poison here. Watch your step, Diana.
I’ve survived worse than smog. Keep smashing their lines, Superman!
They’re deploying heavy hitters to guard the lower levels.
Good. It means they are terrified of what we’ll do to the core.
The heat is rising fast. The whole faultline is about to blow.
Then we strike hard and fast!
They view my power as a gift, but it is a heavy cage.
Inside this cage, I choose to bleed so they will never have to.
Bleeding for them breeds resentment from the very monsters I must overthrow.
To overthrow monsters, I must use the exact power they view as a gift.
You are stepping onto a foundation I built by hand, and I know exactly how much weight it takes to break you.
There are no shadows to hide in here, just two hundred and fifty pounds of solid steel ready to drop.
Every strategy you brought into this arena has a structural flaw.
You can try to move a brick wall if you want, but you will only end up shattering your own hands.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Home Screen Intro
en: So this is S.T.A.R.S. Labs. The high-tech sanctuary. Let's see if their hospitality lives up to their legendary reputation.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Home Screen Intro
en: Clean floors, bright lights... it's a stark contrast to the trenches. I could get used to this kind of war room.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Home Screen Intro
en: I appreciate the formal invite. If they are asking for my help, things must be getting desperate out there.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Home Screen Intro
en: Let's skip the pleasantries and get straight to the briefing. What are we dealing with?

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: The Crime Syndicate hit three locations last night, they're going to the Wild Isle of Hell.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: They dared? Then I'm leaving now.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: Before you go, take whatever you need from the armory.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: I crossed Hell with a sword. I travel light.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: Some of this gear was built to counter metahumans.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: If your weapons worked, you wouldn't have called me.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: Then choose whatever improves our odds.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Store Screen Intro
en: I'll take information. The rest would only slow me down.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Boss Screen Intro
en: Diana, let us help. The Syndicate's army is growing by the second.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Boss Screen Intro
en: The Syndicate is my prey. Step back before I make you a target.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Boss Screen Intro
en: You don't have to carry this weight alone. We can help you.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Boss Screen Intro
en: You’ll only get in my way. I’m ending this threat on my terms.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Boss Screen Intro
en: We won't just stand by while you throw your life away.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Boss Screen Intro
en: Then try to move me. Let's see who bleeds first.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Tower Screen Intro
en: We’ve entered Hell. Syndicate forces are ahead.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Tower Screen Intro
en: Then they will fall. What's the plan?

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Tower Screen Intro
en: We need to clear three zones, and we need to do it fast. No delays, no mistakes.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Tower Screen Intro
en: I don’t plan to leave any of them standing.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Tower Screen Intro
en: If my intel is correct, we'll contact them first in your homeland, the Wild Isle of Hell.

Module: Absolute Wonder Woman - Tower Screen Intro
en: They will pay for having dared to set foot on my land. I will lead.
Gotham doesn't need a hero in a cape. It needs a monster willing to drag it out of the dark.
This isn't just an emblem on my chest. It’s an axe forged to break anyone standing in my way.
No gadgets. No billions. Just raw fury, heavy steel, and a city that will learn what fear truly means.
The rules are gone. If you're staying in this fight, pick up a weapon or get out of my city.
You're tracking dirt onto the blueprints, Clark. The layout of the lower docks has to be precise.
Sorry, it’s hard to keep steady when the whole city feels like it's vibrating under my boots.
That’s just the subway grid. It’s loud, heavy, and raw. You get used to the friction.
I like it here. It smells like oil, sweat, and hard work. Reminds me of home.
It's practical. Just steel, tools, and a plan to fix what's broken.
A good foundation. Just remember to step out from under the heavy iron once in a while.
You're working with the Syndicate. Give me one reason not to stop you.
Because stopping me now helps them more than it helps you.
Then explain yourself.
I can't. Not until this is over. Until then, stay out of this.
You're asking me to ignore everything I've seen?
I'm asking you to look beyond what you see. And stay out of my way.
I won't let criminals use you.
Good. Just make sure you're fighting the right criminals.
Justice isn’t balance. It’s consequence. People understand only what fear teaches them.
Then it is not justice you seek, but control shaped by pain.
Control is what prevents chaos from burying the innocent under its weight.
Mercy too often becomes the door villains walk through again and again.
Justice without mercy becomes tyranny wearing a righteous mask.
True justice must elevate, not merely punish what it cannot understand.
Understanding doesn’t save lives in the moment a blade is falling.
But only understanding ensures we do not become what we fight against.
Look at the horizon. That isn’t a sunrise, soldiers. It’s the frontline coming to us. Grab your gear and hold the line!
Stay with me! Do not close your eyes. We didn't survive the initial blast just to let you bleed out right here.
They thought they could bury us in the ashes. But they forgot one thing: some of us thrive in the absolute dark.
The old world is gone, blown to pieces. We don't fight for flags anymore. We fight just to see tomorrow morning.
Every structure tells a story about the people who built it.
A rushed plan is just a collapse waiting to happen.
I'm looking over the city blueprints. There is always a detail everyone else misses.
The foundation here is solid. It takes a lot of weight to shift it.
